title: Incrementing a digit list
statement: For a natural number base $b$, define the increment of a list of natural-number digits recursively: the empty list remains empty; for a first digit $d$ followed by a list $l$, replace $d$ by $d+1$ and keep the rest when $d+1<b$, and otherwise replace it by zero and increment the remaining list.
